title: How to deactivate your MyServiceNSW Account
summary: This page explains the steps and consequences of deactivating your MyServiceNSW Account.
who_can_apply: You must no longer use your account and will not need it again.
You should only have one account.
You cannot create a new account using the same email address after deactivation.

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your MyServiceNSW Account.
Enter your account password and select the 'Deactivate' button.

internal_links.text: visiting one of our service centres

faqs.q: What happens if I deactivate my account?
faqs.a: You will lose access to services like checking vehicle registrations, paying fines, accessing digital licences and credentials, and viewing associated fines or demerit points balances.

faqs.q: Can I still access NSW Government services without an account?
faqs.a: You can still access services such as checking vehicle registrations, paying fines, and viewing digital licences and credentials.

faqs.q: How do I deactivate my MyServiceNSW Account?
faqs.a: Log in to your account, go to 'Deactivate account', and enter your password and select the 'Deactivate' button.
